fields.claim: The face modulus E = 290 GPa has no source in 047. The cited NASA CR-194164 Table 2 gives 298.7 GPa (L) and 293.6 GPa (LT) for 1.96 mm SR-200 sheet. With 298.7 GPa the check's model lowers the governing face stress 0.57 MPa and raises the SF 1 tolerance about 0.015 mm, one bracket width.
fields.needed_to_ground: Name the modulus source, or carry the finished-sheet modulus range as a sensitivity (with 047-02).

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
